status: read-only pinned source/packaging audit; no build/install/binary execution

sharedPrerequisites.rust: 1.95, complete original Cargo.lock, preserve all default features
macos: Apple clang/linker and platform SDK (CLT or Xcode)
Rust target aarch64-apple-darwin for current local build; x86_64-apple-darwin also required for an upstream-style universal binary
macOS packaging uses lipo, iconutil/sips, plutil, codesign, ditto and hdiutil
Keep platform entitlements and sign every delivered executable/bundle. Apple Developer ID + notarization requires the fork owner credentials. An ad-hoc build is not an officially notarized build.
windows: MSVC toolchain + Windows SDK (rc.exe; signtool.exe for certificate signing)
WiX 5.0.2 + WiX UI extension when building upstream MSI; upstream portable ZIP does not inherently require MSI generation
Upstream packaging builds target with CARGO_TARGET_<TRIPLE>_RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static; preserve this for a portable ZIP without external VC++ CRT requirement
Use actual requested architecture target and matching Windows build tools; retain source app+CLI machine binaries before final branded packaging
packaging: Ship original MIT/Apache licenses, NOTICE when present, asset/contributor/model attribution and KIO-FORK provenance
Copy all font OFL texts for the exact pinned font source, not only the app binary
Check actual produced executable imports and Mac linked libraries before asserting a standalone distribution
notAutomaticallyRequired: No mandatory FFmpeg executable/shared-library, ONNX Runtime DLL, vcpkg or nasm install/staging appears in the reviewed pinned Mac/Windows packaging commands. Do not infer such a dependency from codec/model names. This is a source/packaging audit, not a transitive-link or executed binary audit.

commonWorkflow.warning: Pinned app callers reference @main. For reproducibility use this explicitly reviewed commit instead of mutable main. It checks out exact font ref, builds stable Rust for both Mac targets or Windows matrix, and delegates app packaging to the checked-out app scripts. No upstream signing credentials are provided or reused.
